summary: plan's phase 1 is not implementable as written — it deletes the resource singletons and says consumers read fastify.db/fastify.redis instead, but the consumers are step run() bodies declared at module scope in each workflow's index.ts, with no fastify in scope until plugins/workflow.ts (deferred to phase 2) turns each workflow into a plugin

Second agent's read trace reached well outside its stated phase-1 scope — autoscale.ts, autoscale.test.ts, define.test.ts, atproto-sync/steps.test.ts, run-once.ts, backlog.ts — consistent with searching for a missing piece rather than poor discipline. Confirmed by inspection: StepContext carries no fastify, and recipe-enrichment/index.ts declares 'const enrich: StepSpec = {...}' at module top level

summary: lib/ai/capture.ts captureAiGeneration is async with no await
evidence: oxc lint: capture.ts:125 'Function has no await expression'. The only await was getClient(); plugins/posthog.ts replaced that with a decorator, and client.capture() is synchronous fire-and-forget. Vestigial asyncness left by the S1 extraction

summary: src/workflows/define.test.ts's kernel-level tests are coupled to demo/index.ts's export shape and to demo's presence in the global WORKFLOWS registry, not just to kernel.ts. Converting demo to the fp() plugin path (no more named 'demo' Workflow export, and removed from workflows/index.ts's WORKFLOWS array) breaks it two ways: (1) tsc: TS2614 'Module has no exported member demo' at define.test.ts:5 — a compile-time failure; (2) vitest (esbuild transform doesn't enforce named-export existence) loads fine but 'demo' resolves to undefined, so two tests in the enqueue/jobHost describe block that call host.enqueue("demo", ...) get 'ctx.enqueue: no workflow named "demo"' instead of the expected step-not-found error, since hosts.ts's findWorkflow looks demo up in the now-demo-less registry. Net effect after this conversion: Test Files 1 failed | 11 passed | 2 skipped (14), was 12 passed | 2 skipped; Tests 2 failed | 145 passed | 34 skipped (181), was 147 passed | 34 skipped. oxlint also now flags 4 no-unsafe-* errors at define.test.ts:247,249 because 'demo' typechecks as error/any.
evidence: tsc --noEmit: src/workflows/define.test.ts(5,10): error TS2614. vitest run: FAIL src/workflows/define.test.ts > defineWorkflow > ctx.enqueue > jobHost > two tests, both throwing/asserting 'ctx.enqueue: no workflow named "demo"'. oxlint: 4 errors at define.test.ts:247-249, no-unsafe-member-access/no-unsafe-call on the now-error-typed 'demo'.
